analysis: The trial succeeded with host macro validation HR@10=0.5713, improving over the supplied 0.5600 GRU reference by 0.0113 but falling 0.0024 below the historical 0.5737 reference. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.600, Electronics 0.435, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.645. Electronics declined from the supplied 0.475 reference, so retrieving earlier recurrent states did not resolve its weakness. The aggregate improvement supports further investigation of attention, but does not establish its causal benefit. No test results were available.
code_summary: One independently trained model per category: tied item embeddings feed a two-layer 96-dimensional GRU, followed by learned query/key/value attention over strictly preceding nonpadding GRU states. Fully masked rows receive zero attention summaries. Recurrent states and summaries are concatenated, projected through a linear layer and LayerNorm, then L2-normalized. Scores use normalized tied embeddings, learned scale, and jointly trained item biases. Training retains 64-negative sampled softmax, AdamW, seed 42, and HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking and 25-epoch patience. Prediction right-pads truncated histories, selects the last valid state, and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per dataset; no ensemble or auxiliary fitted scorer is used.
